description: Intended Atlas alert conditions (Admin API v2 alertConfigs) for the primary and ledger clusters, plus which of them each tier can actually raise. Verified 2026-09-30 against the Atlas docs and a failed P4 run (UNSUPPORTED_MATCHER_FIELD): OUTSIDE_METRIC_THRESHOLD is a host alert (host matchers only, host metrics not collected on Free), so it must never be used for Free clusters - it would be accepted without a matcher yet never fire. A Free (M0) cluster raises only Logical Size, as OUTSIDE_SERVERLESS_METRIC_THRESHOLD, which accepts no matchers (project scope = the project's single cluster). Flex adds Connections, Network and Opcounter conditions (OUTSIDE_FLEX_METRIC_THRESHOLD, FLEX_* metric names) - not rendered until those names are verified. Rendered per cluster by scripts/atlas-alerts.mjs, which lists every intended alert its tier cannot raise.

alerts.why: Approaching the 100 ops/s cap (Free: throttled; Flex: next price tier)
One operation type using 40% of the cap
Transactions and findAndModify count as commands
500-connection limit; serverless instances each hold a small pool
Sustained ~7 GB per 7 days of the 10 GB Free allowance
Sustained ~7 GB per 7 days of the 10 GB Free allowance (daily capture reads)
The ledger never deletes receipts; any delete is an anomaly (the ledger-app role has no remove)
